response.sql: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b.double) AS avg_doubles FROM player AS p JOIN batting_postseason AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM player_averages), 0) AS doubles_index FROM player_averages), compared AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, doubles_index, doubles_index - AVG(doubles_index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS index_minus_hand_average FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, doubles_index, index_minus_hand_average FROM compared ORDER BY index_minus_hand_average IS NULL, index_minus_hand_average DESC LIMIT 10;
